predictions: Ok, now here we go!! I popped off a season-best 23-4 last week! The only bummer was that the wrong ones weren't "one-dart result flippers"; the ones I got wrong were all at least 14-10. And weirdly, only one of the wrong ones was in F. It was actually D that dropped me a couple of crap outcomes. Anyway, that brings me to 192-74 (72.2% correct) for the season, which is pretty solid. Let's kick some more butt here.

Match of the week: (F Div.) Down to F, Again @ Death Throw. F division was an anyone-can-win-it situation for a VERY long time, but we are finally starting to get a little clarity. It looks like the race is really down to three teams, these two and the Cheapies. This isn't exactly an elimination match, but it's close. Huge night. Down to F takes a 1001.

Match #2: (D Div.) Point & Rally @ Dart Knights. Rally is one of the five undefeated teams still left, and there is only one team within any reach of them: their recent competitive rivals, the Knights. Well, here we are. Not sure if there is time for the Knights to make up the point deficit too, but a win here pulls them within one match. The Knights' problem is that they keep starting behind in 301. So this is Rally, 14-10.

Match #3: (H Div.) Double Vision @ Dirty Darts (Done Dirt Cheap). Dirty is the only H team within any viable reach of the lead pair, and they absolutely have to win this one if they want a shot at this title. Unfortunately for them, Vision dominates doubles a bit. Vision, 15-9.

Match #4: (G Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Banging the Wire. Wow, did the G race get a jolt last week when Banging went down. Suddenly, 5 of the 7 G teams are within 2 losses of 1st! Machine is on a 3-match run and could pull within 1 with a win. Alas, I think it's Banging, 13-11.

Match #5: (A Div.) Son of a Beach @ Dart Attack. Three weeks ago, Attack was winless and in last place. Now they sit fourth in the entire league, and this matchup is critical. Feels like it's Beach though, 14-10.
Match #6: (G Div.) Aim-ing For Trouble @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. G has become an awesome situation where teams could still fall to H or climb to F. Awesome parity. Throw It gets payback, 13-11.
Match #7: (E Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ Main St Mayhem. There are 3 E teams in a tooth-and-nail fight to avoid the bottom-2 spots (and maybe a drop to F). Two of them here. Mayhem, 14-10.

Matches #8 & #9: (B Div.) Kids who say "Ni!" @ Liquor Posse; Why So Serious? @ Consistently Inconsistent. Serious and the Kids are likely preparing for a week 14 showdown. But before they ever reach that, they better pay attention against other opponents with winning records. Both survive here. Kids, 14-10; Serious, 15-9.
Match #10: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ Nein Mark. We're getting to the point where we start defining the bottom-two in F. It's pretty much a four-team battle. Dillon leads a She Said win, 13-11.

Match #11: (H Div.) Calm Under Pressure @ Afraid of the Dart. Every brand new RDL team eventually has that first victory night. Calm is getting ever closer, man. I'll take Afraid, but narrowly, 14-10.

Match #12: (B Div.) OnlyDarts @ Bottoms Up. Kinda seems like the fates of this pair are kind of sealed… to be favorites in the C race next season! Starting up the rivalry early… OnlyDarts, 13-11 again.
And the remaining 15 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Element 17, Darty Minds 7; Jonesing 17, Wing 7.
C Division: Mulligans Mafia 14, Brutha Ducks 10; Area 501 15, Projectile Dysfunction 9; Darty Little Secrets 15, Still Hump'N 9; Menace 2 Sobriety 15, Pints and Points 9.
D Division: Darty Sanchez 15, Double In Stumble Out 9; Nine Lives 14, The Bullies 10; Shooter McGavin 14, Bandits 10.
E Division: Corks 15, Arrows 9; What's the Point? 14, Dartness 10.
F Division: Cheap Shots 15, Two Time 9.
G Division: Flight Club 14, Cary On Our Wayward Darts 10.
